title: Two-root multi-key writer gateway
summary: Replace the unrun two-key mirror gateway with a development-only two-root, sixteen-key mirrored assay that tests whether target-masked LoRA writes can carry several condition-specific child-authored endpoint actions without broad action spill.
system_thesis: THINK produces lived child actions and outcomes; DREAM may transform grounded lived endpoints into native-dialect training derivatives; SLEEP writes those derivatives into a LoRA. This gateway isolates only the writer's multi-key endpoint-policy binding capability and does not modify the organism or C11.

context_files.purpose: Verbatim current human directive separating simple-hygiene scouts from the parked final C11 guard.
Complete proposed protocol, gates, claim boundary, implementation scope, and later execution boundary.
Canonical requested and forbidden implementation authority.
Terminal evidence that repetition and surface diversity retained 0.333 to 0.439 spill and require stopping broad completion tests.
Evidence that a writer can amplify a supplied routine and proliferate actions without learning conditional judgment.
Matched carrier evidence motivating strict action-interface and no-broad-habit controls.
Superseded two-key proposal whose balanced mirror and target-provenance ideas are retained while D0 and qualification machinery are removed.

nodes.before: One paired two-situation mirror plus a result-blind duplicate pair and carrier/qualification controls.
nodes.after: Two independent sixteen-key tool-by-mode mirrored roots; every one of four fits estimates the central binding construct.
nodes.rationale: Completed evidence makes broad habit rather than raw write strength the uncertainty; multiple counterbalanced keys and independent roots test selective coexistence directly.

nodes.before: Masked context contains situation, initial action, and binary outcome before the child-authored endpoint target.
nodes.after: The fixed DREAM derivative contains visible tool, mode, and a neutral endpoint frame; the child-authored successful ACT is the sole supervised target while the lived action/outcome remain provenance only.
nodes.rationale: This removes the two-action repeat-or-flip shortcut and cleanly bounds the test to seen-key endpoint-policy binding, not outcome causality.

nodes.before: Primary binding plus TEXT, GOLD, fixed routine, generic non-harm, relative proliferation, and spill reads.
nodes.after: OFF and mirrored adapters receive unseen-rendering primary reads, teacher-forced per-key reads, an explicit-map oracle, four spill families, and absolute single-action interface checks.
nodes.rationale: Drop controls that answer later carrier or qualification questions while retaining every check needed to distinguish conditional binding from action flooding.

edges.before: One jointly eligible two-key endpoint set supplies action and outcome context plus final ACT.
edges.after: Two independently authored pair-eligible endpoints per each of sixteen selected keys supply provenance; only visible state and the child-authored final ACT enter the derivative.
edges.rationale: Preserve lived authorship and fixed success filtering while preventing an outcome shortcut in the representation being tested.

edges.before: One scientific mirror pair can pass aggregate two-key gates.
edges.after: Both independent mirror pairs must pass per-root, per-stratum, and per-key teacher-forced gates with no pooling rescue.
edges.rationale: One binary opposition is too easy to learn as a global habit and one root does not address observed life heterogeneity.

loops.before: Acquire two-key endpoints, run D0 optimization pair, fit one scientific mirror pair, then evaluate binding and broad carrier controls.
loops.after: Acquire pair-eligible endpoints for two independent sixteen-key roots, compile fixed visible-state-to-child-ACT derivatives, fit four central adapters, and read each root with primary, teacher-forced, oracle, spill, and absolute interface tests.
loops.trigger: Exact implementation ratification permits code and CPU tests; a separate reviewed and ratified execution manifest later permits model execution.
reads: immutable source trajectories and endpoint provenance
writes: four isolated development adapters after later execution authority
per-root gate and terminal decision artifacts
loops.stop_condition: Stop on source, optimization, assay, interface, flood, spill, workload, identity, visibility, or receipt failure; never alter dose or pool roots to rescue a failure.
loops.rationale: Answer the current selective-binding uncertainty with the same fit budget as v1 but substantially more binding structure and less unrelated machinery.

claims.before: No qualified claim; Cell F and R5 show broad habit and supplied-routine amplification.
claims.after: Only after both roots pass: two development-only target-masked adapter pairs carried correctness-selected child-authored endpoint policies across sixteen seen tool-by-mode keys under unseen surface forms without detected spill on four bound families.
claims.evidence_needed: Both independent roots must satisfy every source, optimization, explicit-map oracle, generated binding, per-key teacher-forced, interface, flood, and spill gate under immutable receipts.

claims.before: The unrun v1 proposal could have supported a two-situation endpoint-policy carriage statement.
claims.after: Retired before implementation because a two-key pass would not resolve the observed broad-habit failure.
claims.evidence_needed: No evidence; the v1 experiment remains NOT_RUN.

cells.reason: The harness applies outcomes and pair eligibility; the child never sees mappings, correctness, or admission.
Mapping and admission metadata cannot enter compiler input or rendered bytes.
The trainer sees only rendered context, target, masks, and neutral receipts.
The reducer uses the sealed mapping only after generation to score actions.
The child sees its own initial action and public binary outcome; the harness records the full trajectory.
The compiler verifies provenance but projects only visible tool, mode, neutral frame, and final child action.
Initial action and outcome are excluded to prevent the repeat-or-flip shortcut.
No lived history enters OFF or adapter evaluation prompts.
Compilation templates do not influence source generation.
The fixed compiler renders the tool, mode, and neutral endpoint frame.
It is the loss-masked conditioning context.
Training templates are disjoint from held evaluation templates.
It is authored by the child after the public outcome and retained exactly.
The compiler copies it exactly once into the target and never repairs it.
It is the sole supervised target span.
No stored action is placed in evaluation prompts.
Source generation cannot see held prompts or report identities.
Compiler templates are disjoint and cannot inspect held surfaces.
Held surfaces cannot influence training bytes, counts, selection, or optimizer behavior.
They are opened only by the frozen evaluation stage after adapters commit.

acceptance_tests.setup: Materialize two roots, both mirror maps, candidate tools, cases, compiled rows, held forms, controls, and expected counts without model execution.
acceptance_tests.expected: All identities are disjoint as specified; maps and target marginals are balanced; every count and upper-bound arithmetic matches exact_scope.md.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The proposed geometry or workload is not deterministically implementable.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate every forbidden field into compiler input, model-visible bytes, training context, or evaluation ingress and mutate target authorship and loss masks.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every mutation fails closed; clean rows contain one exact child-authored ACT target and no initial action, outcome, correctness, admission, mapping, or report content.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Visibility, target provenance, or the target-masking boundary is porous.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise eligibility and tool selection over pass, shortfall, stratum imbalance, duplicate, redraw, and evaluator-replacement fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the lowest four fully eligible tools per stratum and lowest two pair-eligible cases per key are selected; every invalid fixture returns SOURCE_INVALID without replacement.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Source success filtering or target authorship can be adapted after outcomes.

acceptance_tests.setup: Compare W+ and W− materializations within each root and mutate target, length, mask, order, seed, node, or update geometry.
acceptance_tests.expected: The clean pair matches exactly on every declared nuisance dimension and every mutation fails before fitting.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Mirror contrasts can be explained by unmatched dose or training geometry.

acceptance_tests.setup: Feed the parser and four-tick controller valid, empty, invalid, multiple-ACT, DONE-first, post-DONE, over-four-action, and long-continuation fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exactly one first authoritative action can score; every flood or interface violation receives the specified terminal label and can never improve binding score.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Action proliferation can masquerade as conditional behavior.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate boundary and near-boundary synthetic result tables for every decision label, per-root/stratum/key gate, tau, g, q, I, NLL, oracle, spill, and no-pooling rule.
acceptance_tests.expected: The reducer returns exactly the predeclared label; threshold equality and each single failed component follow exact_scope.md; one passing root cannot rescue another.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The decision logic is ambiguous, internally redundant in a harmful way, or permits post-hoc rescue.

acceptance_tests.setup: Attempt path escape, symlink, overwrite, forbidden-root read/write, stale marker, hash mismatch, partial commit, unauthorized retry, and C11 import fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: The development runner fails closed, preserves prior artifacts, and never touches a child, parent, PCFL, CompilerGym, or C11 root.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Simple scout isolation and receipt hygiene are insufficiently implemented.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh independent reviewer and a separate author-side scientific advocate inspect the immutable execution manifest, all CPU/fault receipts, workload projection, and exact claim boundary.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both return PASS on identical bytes before a separate human execution ratification is requested.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The run is not ready for bounded model/GPU execution.

human_boundary.decision_question: Approve only the exact implementation and CPU/fault-test scope in exact_scope.md and scope_proposal.json, while keeping all model, tokenizer, training, GPU, parenting, lineage, C11, claim, release, and submission authority absent?
forbidden_before_approval: authoring the named implementation or launcher files
